values.note: $25 a night for a site without electric, $35 with electric (June 2027). Off-peak (January 2027) $21 and $31. 28 non-electric sites are rated 35-40 ft, so they set the RV base. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-31.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/grid and search/details (facilities 440, 441): Campsite Non-Electric #084 rate 25.00 on 2027-06-15 and 21.00 on 2027-01-19; Campsite Electric #035 and #142 rate 35.00 and 31.00; fee 6.50, read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/grid and search/details (facilities 440, 441): 'Electricity Hookup' '50' on all 25 electric sites rated 23 ft or longer, read 2026-10-31

values.note: 79 electric and 64 non-electric sites in five areas. Only 53 are rated 23 ft or longer (25 electric at 35-58 ft, 28 non-electric at 35-40 ft); the others are rated 13-22 ft, so filter by length when booking. Six long sites are pull-throughs (31, 33, 35, 37, 39, 141).

sites.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/forked-run-state-park-campground ('143 campsites in five camping areas'; '79 electric sites'; '64 non-electric sites') + ReserveOhio search/grid and search/details (facilities 440, 441): VehicleLength per site; PullInTypeName 'Pull Through' on 6 of the 53 long sites, read 2026-10-31

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/forked-run-state-park-campground ('Showers, vault latrines, dump station'; 'The dump station remains open and water is available'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Area 1 is the only area open November 1 through April 1. Its showerhouse closes in winter (ODNR: 'December 5 through April 31'); the dump station stays open and water is available.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/forked-run-state-park-campground ('Area 1 is the only camping area open from November 1 through April 1'), read 2026-10-31

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/forked-run-state-park-campground ('Reservations may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727') + ReserveOhio search/grid and search/details (facilities 440, 441): MaximumStay 14, read 2026-10-31

summary: Confirmed fees $25 base, +$10 electric; not waterfront. Added 143 sites, 58 ft max, pull-throughs, 50A, showers/vault/dump/water, year-round via Area 1, 14-night max, $6.50 fee. Only 53 sites fit 23 ft.
flags: PIN WRONG: stored 39.0890,-81.7930 is about 1.4 km west of the campground, in forest and about 800 m beyond the westernmost site. Corrected: about 39.0907,-81.7768 (centroid of ReserveOhio's per-site coordinates for 146 sites; range 39.0884-39.0931, -81.7839 to -81.7710). The stored elevation was read at the old pin.
PHONE BLANK: the ODNR campground page lists (740) 378-6206 under its emergencies/phone block. It does not label it camp office. Reservations are (866) 644-6727.

Waterfront stays 'not waterfront': on the plotted site coordinates the nearest sites to the lake (e.g. 142, 96) are about 150 m or more through forest, and the Ohio River is about 1 km or more south. No re-audit needed.
AMPERAGE: the details call says '50' on the long electric sites but the map icon for all of them is named 'Trailer.E30', and ODNR doesn't state amps. I wrote 50 from the explicit field.
No split: the five areas share one campground and road system.
